scope.en: The win/lose notices of the Imperial Crusade, the galactic civil war and the Restore the Community war (the player's side).

label.en: Civil war won by the loyalists

note.zh: 保皇方 / 叛军方的通知。

label.en: Civil war won by the rebels

texts.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
texts.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

texts.zh: 只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。
texts.en: Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

texts.zh: 我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。
texts.en: We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.

texts.zh: 我们向[Root.GetRulerTitle]政权投降。
texts.en: We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
texts.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

texts.zh: 很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。
texts.en: Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.

texts.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
texts.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

texts.zh: 你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！
texts.en: You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

texts.zh: 求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。
texts.en: Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

texts.zh: 是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。
texts.en: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.

texts.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
texts.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

texts.zh: 你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。
texts.en: You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

texts.zh:
帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。

[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
texts.en:
Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.

Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

texts.zh: 对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。
texts.en: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.

texts.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

texts.zh: 够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！
texts.en: Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

texts.zh: 我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。
texts.en: We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

texts.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。
texts.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.

texts.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
texts.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！
texts.en: Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

texts.zh: 就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。
texts.en: Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

texts.zh: 你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。
texts.en: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.

texts.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
texts.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

texts.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
texts.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

texts.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
texts.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

texts.zh: 我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？
texts.en: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?

summary.text:
# 银河帝国的战争结果 / Galactic Imperium war results

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/on_action_events_2.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt, common/war_goals/02_event_war_goals.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_war_won（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3122-3131）与 on_war_lost（:3158-3160）列表里的事件：玩家国家（非AI）是战争领袖，且战争使用对应战争目标时触发。
Events in on_war_won / on_war_lost: they fire for a human war leader when the war used the matching war goal.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 帝国远征 wg_imperial_crusade：胜者 action.150（“战胜……”，败方臣服于帝国）/ 败者 action.151（“被……击败”）。
- 银河内战（保皇方 wg_galactic_civil_war_loyalists）：保皇派胜 action.152 / 叛军败 action.153。
- 银河内战（叛军方 wg_galactic_civil_war_rebels）：叛军胜 action.154；皇帝败（叛军 / 恢复共同体）action.155。
- 恢复共同体 wg_restore_the_community：胜者（解散者）action.158。
  Imperial Crusade 150/151; civil war 152/153 (loyalist win), 154/155 (rebel win); Restore the Community 155/158.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 每场战争只触发其中对应的一对/一份；正文按是否集体意识两种。 Only the matching ones fire.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅玩家（非AI）收到。 Human players only.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：action.150-158 的触发（157、156 为注释掉的夺取王座战争）。
- 更正 Corrections：七个单页故事并为一个；帝国内战本身的后续通知见“银河帝国的终结”。
  Seven one-card stories merged; the civil war aftermath is in 'End of the Galactic Imperium'.
